title: A Study of Brenipatide in Participants With Major Depressive Disorder
official: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel-arm Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Adjunctive Treatment With Brenipatide Compared With Placebo in Adult Participants With Major Depressive Disorder Who Have Partial Response to Antidepressant Therapy (RENEW-MDD-3)
summary:
This study evaluates the safety and efficacy of brenipatide (LY3537031) as an add on therapy in participants with major depression who still have symptoms while taking a stable dose of standard of care anti-depressant medicine.

The study will last approximately 5 months.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have a diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) and are in a current major depressive episode, without psychotic features
* Are on a stable antidepressant monotherapy regimen for the current major depressive episode
* Are a partial responder to the current antidepressant monotherapy regimen
* Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and attend required study visits, and are willing and able to follow study procedures as required, such as:

  * self-inject study intervention
  * store and use the provided blinded study intervention, as directed
  * maintain electronic and paper study diaries, as applicable, and
  * complete the required questionnaires

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a lifetime history or current diagnosis of the following:

  * schizophrenia or other psychotic disorder
  * bipolar disorder
  * borderline personality disorder
  * other personality disorders that would interfere with compliance with the study protocol
  * neurocognitive disorders or intellectual disability, or
  * any eating disorder
* Have type 1 diabetes mellitus, or a history of

  * ketoacidosis, or
  * hyperosmolar state or coma
* Have had a history of any substance or alcohol use disorder of any severity within 180 days before Visit 1
* Are actively suicidal or deemed a significant risk for suicide
* Have participated in a clinical study and received active treatment, or unknown if they received active treatment, within 90 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) before Visit 1
